summary: Applies screen-space ambient occlusion to a Render TOP or Render Pass TOP result using the source depth buffer.

key_params.name: samplesteps
key_params.note: Number of sample steps per direction.

key_params.name: ssaopassres
key_params.note: Full, half, or quarter SSAO pass resolution.

key_params.name: combinewithcolor
key_params.note: Composite AO with the source color output.

common_gotchas: Do not insert another TOP between Render/Render Pass and SSAO or depth data will be unavailable.
Turn Combine With Color off when you need standalone ambient occlusion output.
Edge Threshold helps prevent depth-edge bleeding.
Blur controls are part of the intended denoising workflow.
key_concepts: SSAO is a screen-space ambient-occlusion post-process driven by render output depth information.
The input must be directly from a Render TOP or Render Pass TOP so the depth buffer is available.
Performance is driven by screen resolution and sample settings rather than scene object count.
The SSAO pass is expected to be noisy before the built-in blur/sharpness stage.
